payload.title: Publishing skips the full checklist: no per-language checklist, and imported or pod Stories get all steps not applicable
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-19: content is getting published that has not been through the whole checklist, and localizations make it worse. Findings from reading publishing.py, story_checklist.py, localization_publish.py on develop: (1) A translation skips require_checklist_closed entirely: publishing.publish_item calls only require_publishable (original published + no unanswered hold), so a translation's translate/faithfulness/copy-edit steps are 'proven by the run records' and nothing ticks per language; a person-imported or hand-corrected translation (stories correct-translation, imports) has no checklist steps at all. (2) Imported Stories (and pod-loaded Stories since #1691) get a checklist with every step but publishing marked not applicable, so they pass the gate with no review. (3) Rating/illustration gates are the original's only. Wanted: one checklist per language lineage ({story}--{language}), with template steps that apply to a translation (translate, faithfulness, copy edit, human review where the site requires it, rating served by the original), checked on that language's version at publish; the review_people stamp (PPY-97c0f2, provisional) and Always-on agent memory read these per-language rows. Decide the design before building; do not add a fallback. Needs Gherkin for each language case.
